title: Ontology-backed non-circular anomaly benchmark (benchmark-v2)

benchmark_v2.ontology_asset_version: real UMLS 2026AA / SNOMED CT US 20260301 / RxNorm full current

design_rationale.core_idea: Each anomaly is a violation of a RELATIONSHIP between fields, while every individual model-visible token stays common in normal records. This removes the v1 circularity where a single label-free token-presence feature recovered the label (~0.94).

injectors.demographic_incompatibility: Gender FLIP on a record that already contains sex-specific codes (FEMALE_ONLY_PREFIXES / MALE_ONLY_PREFIXES). ZERO tokens injected; only the gender field changes, so the conflict is (sex-specific code, wrong gender) and requires joint reasoning.
injectors.medication_indication_mismatch: REMOVE the indication diagnosis required by a drug already present (insulin->diabetes, anticoagulant->AF/thrombosis, levothyroxine->hypothyroid). Only a diagnosis count changes; the drug token stays common.
injectors.forbidden_cooccurrence: ADD a curated mutually-exclusive partner that is itself mapped and non-rare (type-2 DM E11 <-> type-1 DM E10). The added token is common, not a rare giveaway.

leakage_controls.guard_function: validate_model_visible_fields (raises if any answer-key column reaches model-visible output)

triviality_diagnostic.non_circularity_gate: strongest label-free trivial signal must be < 0.80

demographic_incompatibility.note: SELECTION effect, NOT an injected-token artifact. The gender-flip injects no token; demographic anomalies are only created on records that already contain a sex-specific code, so by construction this subset is enriched for sex-specific tokens. A token-only detector cannot distinguish a flipped record from its source normal (the sequence is identical). The anomaly signal lives entirely in the (gender, code) JOINT relationship, which a label-free token feature cannot read. Documented as acceptable.

comparison_to_v1.v2_status: passes non-circularity gate (<0.80); demographic per-type triviality is a selection effect, not an injected-token artifact

hard_constraints_restated: Ontology-backed SYNTHETIC benchmark, NOT real-world external validation.
Subject-level splits with zero overlap; train split is clean-normal-only for unsupervised training.
Answer keys (original gender, removed/added codes) live only in hidden_eval; never in model-visible input.
next_phase: Phase 3 closure: re-run scoring eval on benchmark-v2 with a (smoke-scale) unsupervised detector to produce valid non-circular detection metrics with bootstrap CIs. Full-scale detector training deferred to a later experiment phase. Do not proceed to Phase 4/5/H200 yet.
